action: If ABL Bio is a partner or supplier, ask the company directly for confirmation before acting; watch for phishing that uses the claim.
date_note: Date SOCRadar logged the leak-site listing, as reported by Daily SECU; the article itself is dated 21 November.
exec: Unverified extortion claim against a listed biotech; relevant if ABL Bio is a partner or supplier.
plain: A ransomware group says it hacked ABL Bio, a Korean drug developer. The company has not confirmed anything, and no break-in or leak has been verified.
summary: Daily SECU reports that the Everest ransomware group claims to have attacked ABL Bio, a KOSDAQ-listed Korean bispecific antibody drug developer, posting its name and domain on its dark-web site. The article says no intrusion or data theft has been confirmed and that it found no statement from the company. SOCRadar logged the listing on 20 November.
title: Everest ransomware group claims hack of Korean drug developer ABL Bio

validation.note: Single publisher (Daily SECU, citing SOCRadar); attacker's claim, no company statement in the article.

review.note: Compared title, claimed status, severity 1, date 20 Nov (SOCRadar log; article 21 Nov), KOSDAQ-listed, no confirmed intrusion and no company statement against the Daily SECU article; single source, unconfirmed_claim is correct
